details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5297-5312 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: If both GNU and BSD `date` parsing fail, `_skip_since_iso` becomes empty and the healthy-PR guard matches all commits.
  WHY: An empty `since` value turns `select(($since == "") or ...)` into an all-commits match, so the guard fails open.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5302-5313 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: API failures are collapsed to `[]`, so the healthy-PR guard fails open when `gh api` does not return commits.
  WHY: `gh_retry ... 2>/dev/null | jq -s 'add // []' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]'` suppresses the error and makes `_skip_recent_autofix` look like zero commits.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:532-534 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The case-insensitive grep can miscount “issues applied” lines because the negative lookbehind `(?<!already )` remains case-sensitive.
  WHY: A line such as `issues ALREADY applied` can bypass the exclusion and inflate the applied count; reviewer confidence ranged from 2 to 3.
- README.md, agents.md:N/A | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Several environment variables used by the scripts are not documented in the repo docs.
  WHY: The reviewers agreed the knobs are discoverable only in source, which makes operational configuration hard.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2646-2660 | severity=medium | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The in-step retry reruns `review_apply_fixes.sh` without clearing any prior partial state.
  WHY: A partially modified working tree can carry over between attempts; one reviewer considered this moderate risk and the other a low-risk intentional recovery pattern.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5297-5310 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If both GNU and BSD `date` parsing fail, `_skip_since_iso` becomes empty and the healthy-PR guard matches all commits.
  WHY: The fallback chain can produce `""`, and `select(($since == "") or ...)` then matches every commit.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5312-5313 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: API failures are silently converted to an empty commit list, so the healthy-PR guard fails open.
  WHY: `gh_retry gh api ... 2>/dev/null | jq -s 'add // []' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]'` suppresses the error and yields `[]`.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:532-534 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The case-insensitive grep can miscount “issues applied” lines because the negative lookbehind `(?<!already )` is still case-sensitive.
  WHY: A line like `Issues ALREADY applied: 5` can be counted as newly applied instead of already applied.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2646-2660 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The retry reruns `review_apply_fixes.sh` without clearing any state from the first attempt.
  WHY: If the first attempt partially modified the tree, the second run can operate on a dirty working tree and mix partial changes.
- README.md, AGENTS.md:N/A | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_DONE`, `AUTOFIX_INSTEP_RETRY_ENABLED`, `SKIP_HEALTHY_PR_GUARD_ENABLED`, `SKIP_HEALTHY_PR_LOOKBACK_HOURS`, and `AUTOFIX_AUDIT_CONVERGENCE_ENABLED` are not documented.
  WHY: The operators cannot discover or configure these environment variables from the repo docs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1633-1644 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The earlier jq-filter finding is already addressed in the current code.
  WHY: The implementation now includes `if type == "array" then .[]? else . end`, so the issue is no longer present.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5297-5312 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If both GNU and BSD date syntaxes fail, `_skip_since_iso` becomes empty and the healthy-PR guard matches all commits.
  WHY: `select(($since == "") or ...)` then treats the lookback window as all time, so old commits are considered recent.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5302-5304 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The healthy-PR guard collapses GitHub API errors to an empty array, so it fails open.
  WHY: `gh_retry gh api ... 2>/dev/null | jq -s 'add // []' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]'` makes `_skip_recent_autofix` become 0 on API failure.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:532 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The grep lookbehind is case-sensitive even though the grep itself is case-insensitive, so “ALREADY” can evade the exclusion.
  WHY: `(?<!already )issues applied` can misclassify lines like `ISSUES ALREADY APPLIED`.
- README.md, agents.md:N/A | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new environment variables are not documented.
  WHY: `MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_DONE`, `AUTOFIX_INSTEP_RETRY_ENABLED`, `SKIP_HEALTHY_PR_GUARD_ENABLED`, `SKIP_HEALTHY_PR_LOOKBACK_HOURS`, and `AUTOFIX_AUDIT_CONVERGENCE_ENABLED` are used in code but not described in the docs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2646-2660 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The in-step retry reruns the fixer without explicitly resetting the working tree state.
  WHY: A partially successful first attempt can leave edits behind that the second attempt then reuses.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5303-5310 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If both GNU and BSD date forms fail, `_skip_since_iso` becomes empty string, causing the jq filter to match all commits.
  WHY: The lookback window collapses to “all time”, so the guard can redirect every skip action regardless of actual recent activity.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5312-5313 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The GitHub API error path collapses to an empty array, so the healthy-PR guard fails open.
  WHY: A transient API failure makes `_skip_recent_autofix` become 0 and bypasses the protection.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:533-534 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The grep pattern uses `-i` but the negative lookbehind `(?<!already )` is still case-sensitive, so uppercase “ALREADY” can skew the count.
  WHY: `_audit_total_applied` can be incremented incorrectly, which can interfere with convergence detection.
- README.md, agents.md:N/A | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new environment variables are not documented.
  WHY: `MAX_STALL_RECOVERIES_DONE`, `AUTOFIX_INSTEP_RETRY_ENABLED`, `SKIP_HEALTHY_PR_GUARD_ENABLED`, `SKIP_HEALTHY_PR_LOOKBACK_HOURS`, and `AUTOFIX_AUDIT_CONVERGENCE_ENABLED` are consumed by the code but absent from the docs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1623-1640 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The earlier jq-filter finding is already fixed in the PR.
  WHY: The code now handles both array and object outputs with `if type == "array" then .[]? else . end`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2646-2660 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The retry reruns `review_apply_fixes.sh` without clearing any prior partial state.
  WHY: A dirty working tree can carry forward partial edits between attempts, though this was also described as an intentional recovery path.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
